run_token_counts_script: run the token_counts.py script to count token occurrences from a binarized dataset for MLM smoothing
run_token_counts_with_custom_vocab: run the token_counts.py script with a custom vocab_size argument for a different tokenizer
run_token_counts_custom_output: run the token_counts.py script specifying a custom token_counts_dump output file path
run_token_counts_custom_input: run the token_counts.py script specifying a custom data_file input path for token counting
summarize_token_counts_script: summarize the token_counts.py script that counts token occurrences for masked language modeling preprocessing
